description.en:
Seirin Academy, a famous academy with a long history, is one of the leading places of education for young ladies far and wide. It is also place where Tsujiura Mio just transferred to, and somewhat... strange. Seirin Academy has a number of taboos, one of which is getting involved with the upperclassman Nekonome Yuuka, someone Mio can't help but be drawn towards. And when Mio does start interacting with Yuuka, she begins getting caught up in all sorts of inexplicable occurrences, after all, Nekonome Yuuka _is not alive_.

So, who, or what, is Nekonome Yuuka? And what secrets are hidden away in the hallways the dainty young ladies of the Academy walk down every day?

La Academia Femenina Seirin, una escuela de prestigio con una larga historia, conocida como uno de los principales lugares de formación para señoritas en la prefectura.

Sin embargo, al conocerla, Mio queda atrapada en una serie de sucesos inexplicables.

Y es que «Nekonome Yuuka está muerta»―...

¿Quién es realmente ella?

¿Y cuál es el “secreto” oculto dentro de esta academia, un elegante cofre donde pasan sus días jóvenes brillantes y encantadoras?

¡El más temible misterio escolar, un horror lleno de perturbadora extrañeza y terror psicológico!

biography.en:
Taiyō Matsumoto (Japanese: 松本 大洋, Hepburn: Matsumoto Taiyō, born October 25, 1967) is a Japanese manga artist from Tokyo. He has won several awards, including the Shogakukan Manga Award, the Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize and Eisner Award.

Matsumoto originally wanted to be a soccer player, but changed to artist as an occupation instead. After his initial success in the Comic Open contest, he began touring France in 1986, an event that became a significant point in his career. The manga he produced covers a variety of topics, from sports to family comedies to science fiction epics.

In 1993, he began work on the [Tekkonkinkreet](https://mangadex.org/title/7661932f-7f80-4c3a-bb37-6861a1477876/tekkon-kinkreet) manga, which became a success in the Big Spirits magazine, and published a series of short stories in a collection called Nihon no Kyodai that was publicized at the time by Comic Aré magazine. [Ping Pong](https://mangadex.org/title/7e435a27-b4fc-417d-94de-30cea79ab6f4/ping-pong) appeared in Big Spirits in 1996, soon followed by the series No. 5 in Shogakukan's Monthly Ikki magazine in 2000.

The Tekkonkinkreet anime was released in Japan in late 2006, and both the anime and manga have been published in English.
biography.zh: 松本大洋，日本漫画家。1967年生于东京，1985年进入和光大学文学系艺术专业，两年后退学。大学时加入过漫画社，自此开始漫画创作。1986年，作品《Straight》获讲坛社漫画杂志《Afternoon》举办的四季新人奖“秋季奖”准入选奖。虽然此作品开始在讲谈社的漫画杂志上开始连载。后转投小学馆，他连续推出了《ZERO》、《花男》、《恶童》、《乒乓》以及短篇作品《青春》，奠定了在漫画界的独特地位。

description.en:
Covered in ice and snow, Elior Forest is the home to dangerous magical beasts and 50 elves frozen in ice. One day, the great spirit Pack helps a young girl break out of her ice prison. Her name is Emilia, a half-elf born with silver hair, long ears, and amethyst eyes—features that resemble the evil Witch who destroyed half the world long ago.  
Shunned by society because of her appearance, Emilia dwells in the forest with Pack as her sole companion and family. Burdened with a sin of destruction she does not remember committing, she spends her days trying to find a way to help her frozen kin. But when the great spirit Melakuera, the Arbitrator of the world, finds Emilia, her right to stay alive is brought into question. Will the bonds of ice she formed with Pack prove to be the warm thread that defies fate?
description.ru: Приквел основной истории «Re: Жизнь с нуля в альтернативном мире». Прошло немало времени с тех пор, как Эмилия пробудилась ото сна посреди незнакомого заснеженного леса. Осознав, что ничего не помнит о прошлой жизни, девушка начинает учиться жить с нуля. В этом ей помогают её новые знакомые: Пак — немного странный, но очень заботливый и добрый Великий дух, встретивший Эмилию сразу после пробуждения, и молчаливые Младшие духи, помогающие ей в повседневности.
description.es-la: En lo más profundo del aislado Gran Bosque de Elior, una tierra helada cubierta de nieve y hielo, vive una niña temida por su parecido con la legendaria Bruja de los Celos. Es la semielfa Emilia, y su única compañía es un espíritu felino llamado Puck. Ambos están animadas por el deber y la culpa, pero nunca llegan a acercarse. En este mundo, los días parecen una eternidad inmutable, pero las pruebas que les esperan son despiadadas como el fuego del infierno...

description.en:
"Today, let's try a rom-com where people can see through clothes!"

At the Secondary Literature Research Club, club president and aspiring editor Takiuchi Aira proposes outrageous rom-com settings for the club to experiment with. But to the aspiring novelist Sasai Sakkai, those settings suddenly become reality, starting with Aira-senpai's clothes actually becoming see-through.

As they use a mysterious power that turns fictional settings into reality, the aspiring writer and aspiring editor work together to create one rom-com plot after another in this fresh romantic comedy.
description.id:
"Hari ini kita coba membuat romcom dengan setting 'bisa melihat pakaian menjadi tembus pandang'!"

Di Klub Penelitian Sastra Sekunder, ketua klub sekaligus calon editor, Takiuchi Aira, mengajak para anggota menyusun berbagai ide romcom yang nyeleneh. Namun, bagi Sasai Sakka yang bercita-cita menjadi penulis, semua setting yang dibuat Aira-senpai tiba-tiba benar-benar menjadi kenyataan, dimulai dari kemampuan melihat pakaian Aira-senpai menjadi tembus pandang.

Dengan kekuatan misterius yang membuat setting fiksi berubah menjadi nyata, seorang calon penulis dan calon editor bersama-sama menciptakan berbagai plot romcom dalam kisah komedi romantis dengan konsep yang unik.

Just as he is on the brink of death, a girl named Ruta, claiming to be a survivor of the supposedly extinct ancient dragon race, appears before him.

Kazuki forms an alliance with Ruta for revenge and gradually awakens to the hidden powers of Soul Power (Chakra) and Soul Armor (Karma)...!

Tells the story of a ghost who accidentally possesses a girl, then takes advantage of the situation to interact with the woman she loves.  
  
- A Kiss, Love, and a Prince  
Takes place in the same setting as "Even if We're Not Friends," but centers around different characters. The main character is kissed by her sempai, who is playing opposite her in the school play, and freaks out because she always imagined her first kiss would be with a boy, preferably a dashing prince.  
  
- This Love from I Can't Remember When  
Tells the story of one girl's unrequited love.  
  
- Cherries For Your Lips  
Tells the story of a girl who's in love with her best friend.  
  
- If I Kiss Her Ring Finger  
Nana wants to take things farther with Hitomi, but Hitomi doesn't seem interested. Meanwhile, Nana's failed her midterms, and she uses the make-up tests as an excuse to avoid Hitomi.  
  
- Real Love  
Michiru confesses her love to her sempai and asks her out.

description.en: Soumatou Kabushikigaisha is a company that offers a very peculiar service. Customers, after giving their name and birthdate, are led to a room with a single television. A woman then brings them a DVD that they may watch as they desire. This DVD is the record of their entire life, from birth to the present moment. These customers may gain new insight into the events of their lives, and discover truths about the people they encounter that they might never have guessed. The first customer is 43-year-old Sugiura Katsumi, whose daughter and wife have died relatively recently. In reviewing his life, all the happiness, sadness, and terrible mistakes come back to him, and the cause of the series of recent tragic events in his life will become painfully clear.

description.en:
Smart, successful and good-looking Iwaya Sumire works for a big newspaper. However, her boss asks her to leave for being too "perfect" a woman. Feeling angry and dejected Iwaya returns home depressed, and most of all lonely. However, when she finds an unconscious young man lying in a box out the front of her home and takes him in. He looks like a dog she used to own called Momo. She dubs him Momo and decides to "keep him as a pet." It's the start of an unexpected life together as they overcome obstacles and become quite attached to one another. But can love like this exist?  
  
This manga won the 2003 Kodansha Manga Award for shōjo.

biography.en:
Born December 1st. Born in Kanagawa prefecture. In 1994, she was selected for the Kodansha "mimi & Kiss Autumn Newcomer Manga Award" and made her debut in December of the same year with "Sugao ni Kiss shite" in "Kiss" magazine. Her masterpiece "Kimi wa Petto" was made into a drama starring Koyuki and Jun Matsumoto in 2003, and won the 27th Kodansha Manga Award in the same year. It was a hit with a cumulative total of over 4 million copies. Was a reporter for Yomiuri Shimbun.
